title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

suppliers.sup:70110: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal on your price adjustment
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for your offer and for the partnership your foundry has shown us over many years, including in 2022.

Our should-cost estimate for part:310010 is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010), below your price. The forecast for part:310010 increased by 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price. PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

Our current agreement ctr:4600070110 runs until the end of 2026, so our packages start the new price later. One alternative keeps your standard payment terms to protect your cash flow. Which of the attached packages works best for you?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal on your price adjustment
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €137.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: a price of €134.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for checking our data and for your step towards us. We value the partnership you showed us in 2022 and want to continue it.

Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).

Both attached packages keep your standard 30-day payment terms, so your cash flow is not affected. The first keeps the later start date you offered. The second starts the new price earlier, from January 2027, in line with the end of our agreement ctr:4600070110. The volume is 8150 pieces per year over 12 months.

Which of the two packages can you sign? Is there a cheaper variant you would suggest?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - revised packages
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We appreciate the volume commitment of 8150 pieces per year, which helps us plan our production. 

Building on your first package, we can offer a price of €133.70 per unit, valid from 1 April 2027, with our standard 30-day payment terms. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €133.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This quote remains valid for 30 days. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - our package from April 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for your revised offer and for building on our first package. We value the reliability and partnership your family foundry has shown us over many years.

Your previous scorecard records 626 ppm (sc:70110@2026Q2).

The attached package keeps the structure you offered: the new price starts on 1 April 2027 and your standard 30-day payment terms apply, so your cash flow is unaffected. The volume is 8150 pieces per year over 12 months, delivered evenly as in your schedule. Your planning is secure through 2027.

Can you sign this package? If a cheaper variant suits your foundry better, for example around invoice timing, we are glad to look at it.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - our package from April 2027
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our foundry values the long relationship between our companies, and we truly appreciate your continued partnership and the volume of 8150 pieces per year. We checked the quality record data you cited; we had already taken this kind of fact into account. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

In response to your revised offer, we can make a further step to €133.50 per unit, keeping the start date of 1 April 2027 and our standard 30-day payment terms. Thus, our current proposal stands at a price of €133.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In response, we are prepared to make a further concession to €133.30 per unit. This keeps the start date of 1 April 2027 and our standard 30-day payment terms, providing stability for both sides.

We are pleased to present this updated Angebot to you today: a price of €133.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. We look forward to continuing our long and successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued partnership and the step you have taken towards our position. For many years, our foundry has stood alongside Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH as a proud and dependable regional partner. We have already made significant concessions to support our long-standing relationship and secure your planning. 

We cannot reduce the price further; therefore, €133.30 per unit is our final offer. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

For our formal Angebot, our offer stands at a price of €133.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days. Our team takes great pride in the quality of the work we deliver, and we would be honored to continue our close cooperation under these clear terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
